verdict.rationale: Founder Law's rebrand page has a first-party statement contrasting automated legal tools that 'handle forms at scale' with its view that complex founder cases need an accountable attorney. That signals an attorney-led posture on its own pages but does not explain how, or whether, the firm itself uses AI in drafting or review. missing for 10: explicit disclosure of which petition drafting or review steps (if any) are AI-automated, a description of which steps a human attorney checks, a dedicated AI-use policy page, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, the provider states how it uses AI in petition drafting and review — what is automated, what a human attorney checks — on its own pages

citations.quote: Complex, high-stakes founder cases require an attorney who is accountable for the outcome.
